FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A04
Time the gap by counting thousand-seconds to a fixed object; the count equals seconds of looking ahead. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A04
Early moves give followers more reaction time, keeping traffic steady and safer for everyone behind. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A07
Back up as little as possible, favoring drive-through spaces; check behind before entering since children and small objects hide from the seat. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A07
Reverse slowly while looking through the rear window with an arm over the seatback, never trusting mirrors alone, and use a guide outside when possible. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A07
Never drive on parking lights alone, and douse spotlights for approaching vehicles; at dusk or overcast, switch headlights on. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A07
Tinted and photo-gray lenses can steal up to thirty percent of night vision, so treat them with caution after dark. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A07
With breakdowns or tire failure, slow gently, regain control before leaving the lane, then pull as far right as safely possible with parking lights on and headlights dimmed at night. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A07
Limit long night drives, breaking at least every two hours for air and alertness, and nap or lodge when drowsy rather than pressing on. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A01
Texting is singled out as the most alarming distraction because it combines visual, manual, and cognitive distraction at the same time [A01].
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A02
Automatic starts need park and manuals need neutral with clutch as required, with the brake set in both cases. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A03
Speedometers correct misjudged speed, while posted limits set the ceiling that bad conditions lower. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A05
A plain green never excuses skipping the left-right check, since cross traffic may run its red. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A06
Mirrors clear the lanes beside and behind, while only an over-shoulder look clears the blind spot. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A04
A city ten-seconds means watching one block ahead, while a highway ten-seconds means four blocks or a quarter mile. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec09-R15 | anchor: A05
One-way to one-way lefts are allowed unless barred, while lefts across oncoming traffic need a safe gap and clear exit. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-R16 | anchor: A03
Hands-free calling still steals attention like hand-held use, while headphones additionally block emergency sound. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0061]
